# gitmoap_repository_member (Resource)

Gives a person a built-in role directly on the repository. Callers who can manage access here may add members (Maintainers and above with the built-in roles), and nobody can give a role above their own. Refused when the person already has a role here, and when the repository's member limit is reached.

The token needs `repo_member:add`, `repo_member:read`, `repo_member:update` and `repo_member:remove`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_level` (String)
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID
- `user_id` (String) User ID

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `visibility` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id and user_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_member.example "<repo_id>/<user_id>"
```
